content.title: Ongoing Drug Therapy for SVT, Oral Administration

drugs.name: Atenolol
precautions: AV block greater than first degree or SA node dysfunction (in absence of pacemaker)
Drugs with SA and/or AV nodal-blocking properties

drugs.name: Metoprolol tartrate
precautions: AV block greater than first degree or SA node dysfunction (in absence of pacemaker)
Drugs with SA and/or AV nodal-blocking properties

drugs.name: Metoprolol succinate (long-acting)
precautions: AV block greater than first degree or SA node dysfunction (in absence of pacemaker)
Drugs with SA and/or AV nodal-blocking properties

drugs.name: Nadolol
precautions: AV block greater than first degree or SA node dysfunction (in absence of pacemaker)
Drugs with SA and/or AV nodal-blocking properties

drugs.name: Propranolol
drugs.initial_daily_dose: 30-60 mg in divided or single dose with long-acting formulations
drugs.max_total_daily_dose: 40-160 mg in divided or single dose with long-acting formulations
precautions: AV block greater than first degree or SA node dysfunction (in absence of pacemaker)
Drugs with SA and/or AV nodal-blocking properties

drugs.name: Diltiazem
drugs.initial_daily_dose: 120 mg daily in divided or single dose with long-acting formulations
drugs.max_total_daily_dose: 360 mg daily in divided or single dose with long-acting formulations
potential_adverse_effects: worsening HF in patients with pre-existing ventricular dysfunction
precautions: AV block greater than first degree or SA node dysfunction (in absence of pacemaker)
Drugs with SA and/or AV nodal-blocking properties
Diltiazem is a substrate of CYP3A4 (major) and a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor

drugs.name: Verapamil
drugs.initial_daily_dose: 120 mg daily in divided or single dose with long-acting formulations
drugs.max_total_daily_dose: 480 mg daily in divided or single dose with long-acting formulations
potential_adverse_effects: worsening HF in patients with pre-existing ventricular dysfunction
pulmonary edema in patients with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
precautions: AV block greater than first degree or SA node dysfunction (in absence of pacemaker)
Verapamil is a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor and also inhibits P-glycoprotein
